title: Fixed Open Long-Bar F Clamp
description: One newly authored complete static long-bar F-form woodworking clamp in a fixed empty opening. A full flat steel guide bar carries a perpendicular fixed end jaw and a second jaw assembly with a real rectangular through-bar collar, complete bridge and genuinely pierced spindle boss. A separate full spindle with a closed visual six-turn helical ridge terminates in an opposed round pressure pad and a thick timber grip; the bar has one integral-purpose end stop. The complete long-bar geometry and open jaw bay differ from the existing table-edge C-mounted bench vise and elevated split bicycle-tube clamp. No old tool mesh is cropped, recoloured or stretched. Eleven editable closed components and three solid untextured PBR materials, metres, native Z up, actual horizontal bounds-centred origin and flat jaw/collar undersides in a laid-down display pose. One complete prop, zero scene. No stock, bench, product-use compatibility, slide path, screw engagement, clamping motion, force, load, thread standard, manufacture, woodworking performance or safety claim.
